name: Innovo RedBox Fury (migration from Garage Pro Quad)

ota.summary: MIGRATION BRIDGE. 'Garage Pro Quad' was renamed to 'RedBox Fury'; this path exists only so units still polling the old manifest URL can move forward. It serves the RedBox Fury 2026.09.21.49 binary (identical ESP32-C3 hardware, fits the old asymmetric app1 slot). After updating, the device reports as innovo-redbox-fury and its Home Assistant entity IDs change accordingly.
